en.headline: CFS urges public not to eat French spread product over possible Listeria contamination
en.dek: A batch of L'atelier Blini Ktipiti Extra Red Pepper & Feta Cheese Spread imported by City Super is being recalled after French authorities flagged a suspected cold-chain problem.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department on 18 August urged the public not to consume a batch of spread product imported from France because it may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.

The product is Ktipiti Extra Red Pepper & Feta Cheese Spread under the brand L'atelier Blini, net weight 175 grams, batch number 12262661, use-by date 30 August 2026. The local importer is City Super Limited.

A CFS spokesman said the centre learned through its Food Incident Surveillance System that France’s Rappel Conso had issued a notice that the product was being recalled because of a suspected cold-chain problem that might have allowed Listeria contamination. The centre contacted the importer at once.

As a precautionary measure, City Super has stopped sales, removed the affected batch from shelves and begun a recall under CFS instructions. Members of the public may call the importer’s hotline 2736 3866 during office hours for recall enquiries.

The CFS said it has contacted the French authorities and will continue to follow up and take appropriate action. An investigation is ongoing. The trade should stop using or selling the affected batch immediately if in possession.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食法國進口塗抹醬 或受李斯特菌污染
zh.dek: 一批由City Super進口的L'atelier Blini Ktipiti特製紅椒菲達芝士醬因法國當局指懷疑冷鏈問題或受李斯特菌污染，正回收。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心於8月18日呼籲市民不要食用一批由法國進口的塗抹醬產品，因為有關產品可能受李斯特菌污染。
涉事產品為品牌「L'atelier Blini」的「Ktipiti Extra Red Pepper & Feta Cheese Spread」（Ktipiti特製紅椒菲達芝士醬），淨重175克，批次編號12262661，此日期或之前食用為2026年8月30日，進口商為City Super Limited。
中心發言人表示，透過食物事故監測系統得悉法國Rappel Conso發出通告，指由於懷疑冷鏈出現問題，有關產品可能受李斯特菌污染，正在當地回收。中心得悉事件後隨即聯絡本地進口商跟進。
作為預防措施，進口商已按中心指示將受影響批次產品停售及下架，並展開回收。市民可於辦公時間致電進口商熱線2736 3866查詢回收事宜。
中心已就事件聯絡法國當局，並會繼續跟進及採取適當行動。調查仍然繼續。業界如持有受影響批次產品，應立即停止使用或出售。
